map.落子必须在某方向夹住至少一枚对方棋子（中间全为己方），落子后把被夹住的对方棋子全: A move must sandwich at least one opponent piece in some direction (all pieces in between are yours), and after placing, all sandwiched opponent pieces are flipped; if no move is available you pass, and the game ends when neither can move, with more pieces winning. ...
map.双人对战：8×8 棋盘轮流落子，翻转夹住的对方棋子。: Two-player match: players alternate placing pieces on an 8x8 board, flipping the opponent's pieces that are sandwiched.
map.策略演示：理解「合法步必翻、抢角占优」的博弈。: Strategy demo: understanding the game theory of "a legal move must flip, taking corners is advantageous".
map.休闲娱乐：终局棋子多者胜。: Casual play: at the end, whoever has more pieces wins.
map.64 格为偶，终局通常分出多寡；极少见完全均分: With 64 cells being an even number, the final count usually splits; a perfect tie is extremely rare
map.抢四角、逼对手少合法步；角稳定不被翻，是核心策略。: Take the corners and force the opponent into fewer legal moves; stable corners that cannot be flipped are the core strategy.
